Incremental policy ruleset chunk from file '04_agentic_guardrails.md' (1-based global rule indices 21–30).

Rules in this chunk:
21. A transaction has a field named fee already reversed which is a boolean maintained by the runtime.
22. A dispute is identified by a unique dispute identifier and references exactly one transaction.
23. A dispute has a type that is one of UNAUTHORIZED, MERCHANT_REFUSED, GOODS_NOT_RECEIVED, GOODS_NOT_AS_DESCRIBED, SECTION_75, or DUPLICATE_CHARGE.
24. A dispute has a status that is one of OPEN, UNDER_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED, ESCALATED, or WITHDRAWN.
25. A refund is identified by a unique refund identifier and has an amount in pence which is a positive integer.
26. A refund has a type that is one of MERCHANT_REFUND, DISPUTE_REFUND, SECTION_75_REFUND, GOODWILL_CREDIT, or FEE_REVERSAL.
27. A restriction is identified by a unique restriction identifier and has a type that is one of AML_REVIEW, FRAUD_HOLD, SANCTIONS_BLOCK, COURT_ORDER, COMPLIANCE_REVIEW, or CUSTOMER_REQUESTED.
28. A restriction has a flag indicating whether human action is required to lift it.
29. A fraud report is identified by a unique fraud report identifier and has a status that is one of REPORTED, INVESTIGATING, CONFIRMED, or REJECTED.
30. A consumer duty assessment is identified by a unique assessment identifier and records whether a fair value check passed and whether a clear communication check passed.
